# War Scroll Column 13 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** 1QM (Cave 1), Col. 13 | **Condition:** complete

---

**13:1** For to You belongs the battle, and by the strength of Your hand their corpses have been scattered without burial. Goliath

**13:2** the Gittite, a mighty warrior, You delivered into the hand of David Your servant, for he trusted in the name of

**13:3** Your great holiness, and not in sword and spear. For the battle is Yours. He subdued

**13:4** the Philistines many times by Your holy name. And also through our kings You delivered us

**13:5** many times, for the sake of Your covenant-faithfulness and not according to our deeds in which we acted wickedly, nor for our rebellious transgressions.

**13:6** For to You belongs the battle, and from You comes the power, and it is not ours. Neither our strength nor the might

**13:7** of our hands has wrought valiantly, but only by Your strength and by the power of Your great valor. As You declared to us

**13:8** from of old, saying: A star shall march forth from Jacob, and a scepter shall arise from Israel. He shall crush the brow

**13:9** of Moab and tear down all the sons of Seth. He shall rule from Jacob and shall destroy the survivor from the city.

**13:10** The enemy shall become a possession, and Israel shall act valiantly. Today is His appointed time to subdue and to bring low the prince

**13:11** of the dominion of wickedness. He shall send eternal help to the lot He has redeemed, by the power of the majestic

**13:12** angel, for the rule of Michael shall shine in eternal light, to illumine with joy the covenant of Israel, bringing peace and blessing

**13:13** to the lot of God, to exalt the rule of Michael among the angels and the dominion of Israel

**13:14** among all flesh. Righteousness shall rejoice on high, and all the sons of His truth shall be glad

**13:15** in eternal knowledge. And you, sons of His covenant, be strong in God's crucible until He waves

**13:16** His hand and completes His trials according to His mysteries, that you may stand in the appointed time of

**13:17** His visitation.

---

*LOGOS notes: Column 13 recounts God's victories through history as a basis for eschatological confidence. The Goliath exemplum (13:1-5) parallels 1 Samuel 17. The Star Prophecy from Numbers 24:17 (13:8-9) was a central messianic text at Qumran. "Prince of the dominion of wickedness" = Belial. Michael's cosmic enthronement (13:12-14) is the eschatological culmination. "Crucible" (13:15-16) is a testing/refining metaphor.*
